query: Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Thornwood . Of the Thornwood tee listings shown, which one advertises the lowest price on the results page, and what is that price?

result.final: The Thornwood tee with the lowest price on the search results page is the 'Thornwood Heavyweight Cotton Tee - Dunmore Apparel' at $12.91. This was found by reviewing all 15 Thornwood tee listings across both pages of the search results (12 items on page 1 and 3 items on page 2).
